// privatePackages: Inert while the root package.json says `private: false`, and kept anyway.
changesets skips versioning and tagging private packages by default, so if
`private` is ever set back to true — which is the natural instinct for a
desktop app that must never reach npm — these two flags are the only thing
keeping the release chain alive. Without them `changeset tag` prints
nothing and exits 0: no tag, so build.yml never runs, so a release with no
installers, and nothing red anywhere. That is the exact failure v0.2.0 had.
See changesets' docs/versioning-apps.md, which prescribes both flags for
